sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a quick yordle run, the cannon held level at her hip, the LEGS SWAPPING every half cycle, the body bobbing with each step
sheets.weapons: THE CANNON goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): held in BOTH hands, LEVEL at her hip with the MUZZLE to the RIGHT unless the pale figure tips it down, swings it up or rides it. Only ONE cannon, the design's (brass and wood, the flared blue-grey muzzle).
sheets.legs: Frame 1: PUSH-OFF: one foot planted under her hips, the other leg kicked back behind her, its foot up off the ground. Frame 2: CONTACT: the back foot comes down - both feet on the ground, apart, the back one behind (left), the front one ahead (right). The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) is the one that kicks back, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one). Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly - frames 1, 4, 5 and 8 have a foot off the ground; never the same leg pose in every frame.
